create_PPO: create a PPO reinforcement learning agent with an actor-critic network and configurable clipping parameters
update_PPO: update the PPO agent by running multiple epochs of mini-batch policy optimization on collected rollouts
get_advantages_PPO: get normalized or raw advantages from rollouts by computing returns minus value predictions
test_PPO_update: test the PPO update method with rollouts containing observations, actions, and value predictions
review_PPO_before_step: review the PPO before_step hook that clips gradient norms on actor-critic parameters before optimizer step
